dannemann--speciale.description: Dannemann's Speciale is a short, unfiltered cigarillo of 6.8 cm, machine-made in Germany and long a classic of the range. The Brasil version has a Mata Fina wrapper from Brazil and a hearty, spicy taste; the Sumatra uses a Java wrapper and smokes full and aromatic. A slightly longer Gold version is the milder choice.

dannemann--cigarillos.description: Tracing back to the factory Geraldo Dannemann opened in São Félix, Brazil, in 1872, this machine-made German range covers several cigarillo formats. The Pierrot Brasil, a thicker señorita, has a Mata Fina wrapper and the Menor a Java leaf, while Samba and the small, lighter Mini Con Filtro blend Virginia, Burley and Oriental tobaccos behind an activated-carbon filter, honey-sweetened on the Samba.

dannemann--collofino.description: The Collofino No. 60 is a slim, machine-made Dannemann cigar of about 13 cm, sold in fives and ready to smoke with a pre-cut foot. Its filler blends tobaccos from Brazil and Sumatra, and both the Brasil and Sumatra versions give an intense, aromatic smoke, the Brasil adding woody and grassy notes.
